html:
SMTO-CFG-0016 — SMTO didn't recognize a setting your page tried to change

GUID: d2cfa865-d741-4f48-a8ab-3bc3b4c8e261
Slug: composer-field-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • The page asked SMTO to change a message-box setting that this SMTO doesn't have. This usually means the page in your browser is from a different SMTO version than the server. Nothing was saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the SMTO page in your browser, then open the conversation again from the Conversations pane. Reloading loads the page version that matches the server, so it only offers settings the server knows.
  2. Make your change again with the controls above the message box, and check that no error appears there. After reloading, the change is sent in a form the server accepts.
  3. If a tool or script changes conversation settings for you, ask its owner to update it for this SMTO version. Older or newer tools can send setting names this server doesn't have.

What success looks like

  • Your change is still there after you reload the page, and no error shows above the message box.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO, saying which control you changed. Don't keep selecting Retry settings; it resends the same unknown setting.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The composer profile change was rejected because ComposerPatch.changes contains keys that are not ComposerValues fields.

What this means

  • Composer patch changes include keys outside ComposerValues.model_fields. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Composer patch changes include keys outside ComposerValues.model_fields.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare submitted change keys with the current composer schema, excluding server-owned profile metadata.

How to fix it

  • Send only keys defined by ComposerValues (the fields list in conversation_composer_profile.js mirrors it). An unknown key means the browser bundle or API client and the Server are different versions; hard-reload the UI or update the client.
  • Submit only fields advertised by the current composer schema.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The patch contains only supported preference fields.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
